description: This file is a shell script that defines a test suite for verifying the handling of empty symlinks in a git-svn integrated environment. It loads a sample SVN dump, clones repositories, configures workarounds for broken symlinks, and performs assertions to validate behavior with symlinks in SVN and Git.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Sets up a test case expecting success, running the subsequent commands.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks that a specified file is empty.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
